sources.label: EMA Sycrest RMP publication
sources.result: First published November 3; RMP version 5.2, April 30 data lock and September 4 sign-off. PSUSA/00000256/202508 led to removal of concerns from the RMP list while routine pharmacovigilance and risk minimisation remain. This is not absence of adverse effects, a new tic treatment finding or a new class-wide warning. Asenapine is outside this named treatment watch; historical indication is adult bipolar mania. Product-information update remains February 25.
